panels.title: Mounts up
panels.description: Mounts attached and running, out of the configured total.

panels.title: Pending uploads
panels.description: Writes acknowledged to clients that are still only in the gateway's cache.

panels.title: Upload errors
panels.description: Cached files rclone failed to upload - they exist only in the cache volume.

panels.title: File operations
panels.description: From Samba's audit log: writes, renames, deletes, mkdirs, share connects. Directory/file reads are in the next panel.

panels.title: Failed file operations
panels.description: E.g. writes to read-only mounts, permission errors.

panels.title: Logins
panels.description: Login attempts; result is ok or the NT status (e.g. NT_STATUS_WRONG_PASSWORD).

panels.title: Mounts
panels.description: 1 = mounted. transport: nfs (loopback, with change feed) or fuse.

panels.title: Listing cache
panels.description: Directories and files rclone currently holds listings for.

panels.title: Change events
panels.description: Ceph RGW bucket notifications and Syncthing events.

panels.title: Directory refreshes
panels.description: ok, missing (folder gone - its parent was refreshed instead) or error.

panels.title: Refresh latency
panels.description: Time to re-list one folder from S3/SFTP.

panels.title: Kernel cache kicks
panels.description: NFS mtime bumps that make the kernel re-read a refreshed folder.

panels.title: Change feeds
panels.description: 1 = the bucket notification is set up / the Syncthing feed is connected.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: The whole container: smbd, every rclone and restic, the gateway itself.

panels.title: Logs
panels.description: Everything the gateway, smbd, rclone and restic log, as JSON. Expand a line for all fields; lines inside a trace link to it.

panels.title: Recent traces
panels.description: Each Ceph/Syncthing event, the cache-invalidation batch it fed into (linked), folder refreshes and kernel kicks; mount launches.
